test.title: Global mirror boundary language audit

parameters.sourceModel: Exact frozen row word/omission choices in SOURCE_MODEL.json; no new geometry fit.
parameters.sourceModelChecks: All 16 pair/color/edge scopes, printed row order, canonical word IDs, membership states and first/last options verified; masks retained as pinned provenance.
parameters.sourceTokenInvariant: Every possible selected token must be a nonempty string, have an alphanumeric code point, and contain no Unicode whitespace; violation is inconclusive.
parameters.formLanguageReduction: Compacted spaced equals joined; joined and initials contain no whitespace. Thus 24 language descriptors cover the exact/compact union. They need not be disjoint.
parameters.candidateSemantics: Set union of reachable shaped records across all modeled paths/languages. No occurrence counts, unique-text counts or unique-form counts are claimed.
parameters.minikeyShape: Embedded S plus Base58 characters, total 22/30.
parameters.hexShape: Exactly 64hex code points with realizable nonhex/start and nonhex/EOF boundaries.
parameters.bip39Tokenization: Lowercase unfiltered ASCII lexical tokens matching [A-Za-z0-9]+ with internal straight/curly apostrophe joins; ordinary punctuation boundaries; invalid decoded group ␞ is a hard region boundary.
parameters.capPolicy: Any cap exceedance makes scope incomplete and result inconclusive; partial candidates remain private and are separately assessed.

test.negativeCriterion: A complete zero-valid-record result excludes only the four declared literal formats from the exact registered global modeled language union at the pinned bytes. It does not calibrate scan errors, establish a creator-selected stencil, or exhaust mirror/first-word ciphers.
limitations: The frozen source guard squares and rectangle masks are heuristic investigator conventions, not calibrated physical error bounds or creator instructions.
Independent memberships admit physically inconsistent choices. This enlarges the tested set; a weak checksum match has no implied intentionality or likelihood.
Results count unique shaped values and validated records, not expanded full readings, unique strings, occurrences or independent theories.
Other page orders, masks, selection conventions, projections, encodings and wallet interpretations remain outside this exact test.

candidatePrivacy: Raw unique shaped values remain private until reviewed. Publish only safe domain-separated fingerprints for valid records. Candidate values are saved; path witnesses are not promised by this implementation. Any positive requires separate source/witness review. No wallet, derivation, network query or transaction.

independentReview.reviewScope: Independent mathematical/static and exhaustive synthetic oracle/lifecycle checks; no target candidate-union or checksum test.

accounting: 43,347,744 modeled source paths and 260,086,464 theoretical labeled readings describe the language. Neither is an executed full-string count. Only unique candidate sets, graph checks and resource visits are reported.
